[img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/09_tornado_orbit"][/img][/p][p]
[b][i]Features[/i][/b]
 
- Play at your own pace. Nothing in the game is going to rush you.   
- Controller Support for Xbox and Playstation

- More than 50 collectibles to wash and decorate

app[content][short_description]:
Cast your net to clean up a dirty lake and bring nature back in this cozy, relaxing game.
With cute dogs as helpers, recycle trash and earn money to upgrade your gear.
Lots of hidden treasures to find and wash, in a satisfying mini-game to decorate your house.
Wildlife appreciates your work.
